title: Trade candidate (contract v2.1)
description: One thing a trader might buy or short. Same shape whether it came from a Wagner Daily alert, the scanner, or manual entry.

entry.description: Trigger price. Long: stop < entry. Short: stop > entry.

stop.description: Null only when stop_pending is true (Rick opened the trade with 'stop to follow by alert').

sector.description: GICS-style sector name. Needed for the 50% sector cap (A-23). Null if unknown; engine then skips A-23 and adds a warn block.

setup_type.description: Core setups per D-1; flat_base, cup_and_handle and double_bottom are base types. high_tight_flag is Practice only (C-3).

grade.description: Engine grade when the A-13 rubric exists. Until then null.

self_declared_a_grade.description: Trader says this is an A-grade setup. Unlocks profile.risk_pct_a_grade in Buy Mode only (D-3). Logged.

entry_method.description: gap = gap entry rule A-10 applies.

stop_basis.description: Why the stop is where it is (swing_low, ema8, ema20, reversal_day_low). Judgment tier, never scored.

size_factor.description: Rick's size call on the alert: 1 = full size, 0.5 = half, 0.25 = quarter. The engine multiplies the trader's risk_pct (or risk_pct_a_grade) by this BEFORE the formula. Caps still apply. Missing = 1.

stop_pending.description: Rick has not set the stop yet. The engine returns STOP_PENDING and sizes nothing. Only the platform sets this, for Wagner Daily alerts.
